name: Thai Chicken & Zucchini Noodle Salad with Spicy Almond Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or press the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. In a medium bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the minced garlic and ginger, almond butter, tamari, water, lime juice, and crushed red pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
2 tbsp natural almond butter
1 tbsp tamari soy sauce
½ lime
⅛ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the carrots and zucchini. Trim off and discard the ends of the carrots and zucchini. Using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrots and zucchini into thin noodle-like sticks; transfer them to a large bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside to cool.

Once the chicken has been removed, add more coconut oil to the skillet. Then add the carrot and zucchini noodles. (Keep the bowl nearby.) Cook the vegetables, stirring constantly, until just tender, 2-3 minutes. Transfer back to the original bowl.
Wash and dry the cilantro. Shave the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the noodles.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized cubes and add to the bowl. Toss the salad until well combined.
To serve, place the salad in bowls, pour the sauce over top, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
